About

I come from a farming family, so this work is personal. I like being in the middle of the conversation, with farmers, mills, brands and governments around the same table, talking honestly about what's hard and what's possible.

I don't think a standard solves every problem. What it does is give people with different backgrounds and perspectives a shared way to talk about the same things, and that's where improvement starts. I love talking with people and thinking forward.

Fluent in English and Thai. B.A. in Economics, Michigan State University (2013 – 2018).
